newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASKETBALL-FIBA REJECT BESIKTAS APPEAL OVER BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-FIBA REJECT BESIKTAS APPEAL OVER BRAWL.

text.p: The International Basketball Federation (FIBA) on Thursday rejected an appeal by Turkey's Besiktas Istanbul against a decision to replay a match against Greece's Aris Thessaloniki, abandoned due to a brawl.

Twenty players were ejected for fighting and the game was abandoned because too few were left to play on. FIBA declared the December 11 match void and ordered it replayed behind closed doors in Athens, rather than Salonika.
Thessaloniki were fined 45,000 German marks ($29,200), Gary Alexander of Istanbul was suspended for four games and Constantinos Angelidis of Thessaloniki was banned for three matches.
FIBA's jury of appeal on Thursday upheld the decisions made last month and in addition ordered Thessaloniki to pay Besiktas's travelling and accommodation expenses for the replay on January 7.
The fight started when Alexander grabbed Angelidis from behind and threw him out of the court. Other players joined in and the match was quickly abandoned.
